codeFindings.finding: The changed confirmation still uses interfaceText for directory.name, so opaque path text is inserted into the native confirm without direction isolation. interfaceDialogText is designed for native confirmation strings but isolates every parameter; passing it unchanged wraps count in FSI/PDI, causing Number(FSI + digits + PDI) to be NaN and leaving raw ICU selector syntax.
codeFindings.recommendation: Use a plural-aware native-dialog formatter that preserves numeric selector arguments for Intl.PluralRules while isolating ordinary opaque placeholders such as directory. Do not replace interfaceText with interfaceDialogText unchanged.
